name: LRU Cache
description: Least Recently Used cache using a HashMap + Doubly Linked List. Achieves O(1) get and put by combining O(1) hash lookup with O(1) node removal.
aim: Implement a cache that evicts the least recently used entry when full. Uses hash map for O(1) access and doubly linked list for O(1) insertion/deletion.
howItWorks: Doubly linked list: most recent at head, least recent at tail
Get(key): move node to head, return value
Put(key,val): if exists update+move; else add at head; if over capacity evict tail

time.worstCase: Same — hash map + DLL both O(1)

complexity.spaceDescription: Stores at most capacity key-value pairs

alternatives: LFU cache — evicts least frequently used
FIFO cache — simpler, evicts oldest regardless of use

inputHint: The FIRST number is the cache capacity; the rest are the keys accessed, in order.
